This is a rough estimate from the photo, broken down by item:

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Wrap, cut in two (tortilla, cheese, meat, lettuce, carrot, avocado) | ~250 | ~400 |
| Fruit salad (watermelon, melon, grapes, orange, blueberry) | ~200 | ~70 |
| Orange juice | ~240 | ~110 |
| **Total** | **~690** | **~580** |

I rounded the total up to 720 g and 640 kcal to allow for extra filling or spread in the wrap that isn't visible.
